properties.name: cors.allowedOrigins
properties.description: A list of allowed origins for CORS requests.

properties.name: security.secret-key
properties.description: A secure, randomly generated string used to sign and verify JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). This key should be kept confidential and must be strong (e.g., include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols) to ensure the integrity of the tokens.

properties.name: security.jwt-cookie.secure
properties.description: Set httpOnly and Secure flags on JWT cookies. In production, this should be true to ensure cookies are only sent over HTTPS and are inaccessible to JavaScript. In development, it can be false if using HTTP.

properties.name: security.jwt-cookie.sameSite
properties.description: Set the SameSite attribute for JWT cookies. Use 'Strict' or 'Lax' when the frontend and backend are on the same domain to enhance security. Use 'None' when they are on different domains, but ensure that the Secure flag is also set to true in this case.
